At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary
Responsible for planning, scheduling, employee oversite, and management of Underground Maintenance and Inspection projects. Assists Project Manager in coordinating activities of employees engaged in construction process, utilizing knowledge of equipment, techniques, procedures, and specifications. This position is responsible for assisting craft supervision to coordinating activities of workers engaged in construction process, utilizing knowledge of equipment, techniques, procedures, and specifications.

 

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Understand how to read project drawings.
  • Knowledge of national and local code requirements relevant to this discipline.
  • Supervises the daily work of employees.
  • Support estimating effort through bid reviews and constructability reviews, including review of activity productions, crew makeup, equipment selection and cost analysis.
  • Understand how to generate and manage a 3 week and 6 week look ahead schedule to ensure manpower, materials, equipment, subcontractors, and all resources are scheduled appropriately.
  • Assures all employees within the team know and follow the company safety and work rules and policies.
  • Participates in review of job costs and overall performance with a particular focus on production
  • Supports planning of on-the-job training for team members to ensure safety and quality of the work being done. Timely review of job sites for safety and quality of the work.
  • Work closely with clients of the operations to create new opportunities for Loenbro.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned by Supervisor

 

Minimum Qualifications

Required:

  • Minimum of 5 years of Superintendent experience in the construction of industrial projects.
  • Experience managing projects and leading crews of up to 12 or more personals
  • Understanding of Industry standard scheduling software and reports, Microsoft Office Suite
  • Valid Driver’s license with a clean driving record and Completion of OSHA 30 or equivalent safety training.
  • Trench Safety Training
  • Have a background in underground installation of piping, trench and excavating experience, and underground boring experience.

 

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

Work Environment:

  • External work environments
  • Potential exposure to extreme cold and hot temperatures
  • Manufacturing and Industrial environments
  • Fit and move in confined spaces including tanks and vessels
  • Exposure to noise above 85 decibels and intense odors
  • Exposure to areas with limited visibility
  • Climbing up and down stairs and ladders to both get in and out of trenches and up to elevated platforms (scaffolding at significant heights)
  • Lifting necessary equipment and materials 1-50 pounds
  • If driving is required, valid driver license and proof of insurability is required. All drivers are subject to a DMV background records search

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

 

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

title: Architectural BIM Technician
location: Dallas, Texas, United States; Des Moines, Iowa, United States; Houston, Texas, United States; Omaha, Nebraska, United States
description:
DLR Group is an integrated design firm with a promise to elevate the human experience through design. This fuels the work we do around the world and inspires our mission to improve the lives of our clients, our communities, and our planet. If this sparks your interest, you’re in the right place.Our Reality Capture team has an opening for a Reality Capture Technician / Architectural BIM Technician. This role could be based in the following studios:

Dallas
Des Moines
Houston
Omaha

About Reality Capture at DLR Group
The Reality Capture team utilizes a combination of lidar 3D scans, photogrammetry, photographs, and construction documents to create 3D models that elevate accuracy and safety throughout the lifecycle of our projects. Reality capture delivers ultra-precise documentation that captures details invisible to traditional methods. From historic preservation to commercial development, reality capture accelerates design phases and reduces costs.
Position Summary
As a Reality Capture Technician / Architectural BIM Technician, you will use advanced technology to quickly develop digital models of existing buildings and spaces. This is a role where attention to detail is a must, as the deliverable is leveraged by DLR Group design teams or clients. Utilizing Revit, Capture, and visualization software, you will translate LiDAR or photogrammetry data into 3D BIM models or other deliverables.
DLR Group is 100% employee owned and as such you’ll enjoy the opportunity to have ownership in the Firm. We rely on all our employee-owners to apply their financial acumen to grow the Firm profitably. 
What You Will Do

Communicate effectively with the Reality Capture team
Prepare high-quality 3D models, drawings, or similar deliverables
Perform Revit modeling from 3D point clouds
Work in a fast-paced team environment to complete tasks accurately and efficiently
Coordinate with architects and engineers on various projects
Understand and follow DLR Group and client-standard BIM procedures for model setup, as well as standard drawing procedures for sheet layout
Learn advanced Revit techniques and advanced technology topics
Meet critical deadlines through efficient time management
Communicate effectively with design teams
Work with the Reality Capture team to leverage advanced technology

Required Qualifications

2-3 years of Revit-related professional experience
Understanding of building components
Ability to manage and develop Revit families
Working knowledge of construction documentation, with the ability to develop models that are usable for design, documentation, and scheduling
Ability to plan daily activities to meet production requirements
Flexibility to work with numerous project teams to support project completion
Associate degree or currently pursuing an associate degree in Engineering Technology, Architectural Engineering, Computer-Aided Drafting, or a related field
Must be eligible to work in the United States without need for work visa or residency sponsorship

Visa sponsorship is not offered for this position, including temporary visas such as E, F-1 (including OPT and CPT), TN, J, H-1B, or those who need employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.
#LI-MISDLR Group is an integrated design firm delivering architecture, engineering, interiors, planning, and building optimization for new builds, renovations, and adaptive reuse projects.
We are 100% employee-owned: every employee is literally invested in our clients’ success. At the core of our firm are interdisciplinary teams engaged in every step of project lifecycles. Our teams champion true collaboration, open information sharing, shared risk and reward, value-based decision making, and proficient use of technology to deliver exceptional design. We are pursuing the goals of the 2030 Challenge, the ME2040, and the SE2050, and are an initial signatory of the China Accord and the AIA 2030 Commitment.
Through our values – commitment, creativity, environmental stewardship, fun, integrity, ownership, sharing, teamwork – we elevate the human experience through design, together.DLR Group follows a four-day in-office work model, with employees having the flexibility to work somewhere other than the office on Fridays.
We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action/M/F/Veteran/Disabled employer.

title: Concrete Carpenter
description:
At Keeley Companies, we believe in empowering our people and fulfilling career aspirations. Keeley is a career destination with countless opportunities for advancement, and a world-class family culture that is centered around creating the best possible environment for our people to thrive. 

Keeley Construction is seeking an experienced Concrete Carpenter to join our construction team, with a strong emphasis on striping expertise.
Job Responsibilities
 
Concrete Carpentry Support:

Read and interpret blueprints, drawings, and specifications to determine dimensions and materials needed for concrete formwork.
Build, erect, install, and repair concrete forms and structures using wood, metal, or other materials.
Measure, cut, and shape wood, plastic, or other materials to create precise formwork for concrete pouring.
Construct and set forms for foundations, walls, columns, stairs, and other concrete structures.
Ensure proper alignment, leveling, and bracing of forms to meet specifications and ensure stability.
Install expansion joints and embedded items in concrete structures as specified.
Strip and dismantle formwork after concrete has sufficiently cured.
Maintain and care for equipment, tools, and materials used in concrete carpentry and striping work.
Check completed formwork for quality, stability, and compliance with specifications.
Apply curing compounds or perform additional concrete finishing tasks as needed.

Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent.
2+ years of experience in concrete formwork and carpentry.
Proven ability to read and interpret construction blueprints and specifications.
Experience with various forming systems (traditional wood forms, modular systems, etc.).
Proficiency with carpentry tools and equipment specific to concrete work.
Strong understanding of concrete properties and curing requirements.
Knowledge of proper forming techniques for various concrete elements.
Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and precision.

All candidates must agree to complete a skills assessment and pre‑employment drug screen.EOE/AA M/F/Disabled/Vet

About Loenbro
Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.
At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.
 
Job SummaryLoenbro is looking for a dedicated and hardworking Construction Laborers / Helpers to join our team. The ideal candidate will assist in various construction tasks, ensuring projects are completed safely and efficiently. This is a physically demanding role that requires mindfulness and the ability to work well in a team.
Essential Job Responsibilities

Assist with the setup and cleanup of construction sites.
Load and unload materials and equipment.
Operate hand and power tools under supervision.
Dig trenches, backfill excavations, and compact soil.
Assist with the installation of construction materials, such as pipes, concrete, and steel.
Follow safety protocols and maintain a clean work area.

Minimum Qualifications
Required:

GED or High School Diploma.
Ability to work from ladders and scaffolds.
Lift & carry objects and materials of various weights. 

Preferred:

Skilled in math which includes adding and subtracting fractions.
Able to pass preliminary and periodic drug testing.

Physical Demands and Work Environment
The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Work Environment:

Potential exposure to extreme cold and hot temperatures.
Manufacturing, pipeline, and refining environment.
Fit and move in confined spaces including tanks and vessels.
Limited working surfaces.
Exposure to noise above 85 decibels and intense odors.
Exposure to areas with limited visibility.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) retirement plan with company match
Paid time off (PTO)
Life and disability insurance
Professional development and training opportunities

Job Summary:
This position is responsible for welding on industrial and construction projects, ensuring safety, quality, and timely completion of work. The Welder will work closely with the Foremen/Superintendent to ensure project goals are met. The role involves unloading, stacking, and organizing steel materials, erecting structural steel, and performing welding tasks on construction sites. Additionally, may assist with minor mechanical repairs or installations. Requires the ability to operate heavy equipment such as manlifts, forklifts, etc.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

 Safety
 Follow all safety policies and procedures on the job site.
 Attend daily safety meetings and toolbox talks with the crew.
 Identify and address potential safety hazards immediately.
 Ensure use of required PPE.
 Key Responsibilities:
 Ensure all work is performed to the highest quality standards and in accordance with project specifications and industry best practices.
 Maintain accurate records of work performed, including daily logs and material usage.
 Coordinate with other trades on the job site.
 Work with Foremen to troubleshoot and resolve any on-site issues that may arise.
 Maintain a clean and organized work area.
 Ensure all welds meet required standards and specifications.
 Identify and correct any defects or deficiencies.

Qualifications:

Minimum 2 years of experience as an Iron Worker/Welder.
Strong knowledge of ironworking and welding techniques, including layout and erection.
Experience with a variety of welding processes (e.g., 3G, 4G, SMAW).
Excellent safety record and a strong commitment to safety.
Strong communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to problem-solve and make quick decisions.
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
OSHA 10 or 30 certification preferred.
First Aid/CPR certification preferred.
Ability to travel outside of AZ

Physical Demands:

Ability to lift and up to 75 pounds.
Ability to work in various weather conditions.
Ability to stand, bend stretch and climb for extended periods.
Ability to work at heights.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies. 
 
Benefits 
Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team: 

Medical, dental, and vision insurance 

401(k) retirement plan with company match 

Paid time off (PTO) 

Life and disability insurance 

Professional development and training opportunities 

Employee assistance program (EAP) 

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

2+ years of experience in personnel leadership role or project management role for civil, utility, or facility-related construction

title: Sr. Construction Superintendent
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.SR. CONSTRUCTION SUPERINTENDENTAs a member of the Construction Projects Team, you will be responsible for overseeing the coordination and field execution of facilities construction projects. You will work with design engineers, construction project managers, facilities and maintenance technicians, vendors, and internal partners to support these goals. You will have the opportunity to drive positive change and own projects from start to finish, with the goal of making the SpaceX campus a world-class facility. This position is based in College Station, TX.
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Coordinate facilities projects to ensure vendors meet standards while delivering promised services, materials, and craftsmanship
Plan and direct construction activities of internal resources as well as all involved subcontractors for each phase of construction and lead any coordination meetings between trades
Work hand in-hand with Construction Projects Team to maintain accurate records of daily logs, progress reports, financial reports related to the construction of facilities
Enforce contract expectations from subcontractors and communication of any discrepancies
Approve work being performed by subcontractors and handle any related issue
Authorize payments of subcontractors upon thorough inspection of work
Maintain a safe work site by implementing safety requirements, enforcing safe work habits, observing OSHA requirements and any applicable agencies' regulations
Verify all checklists are complete and inspections are scheduled and passed
Monitor cleanliness and hold subcontractors responsible for daily clean-up
Schedule and manage subcontractors to make designated warranty repairs
Develop and maintain rapport with subcontractors, operators, and inspectors
Coordinate inspections with local officials
Review and manage project request tickets including creating work orders when needed and managing its completion
Create purchase orders as necessary to support project timely execution including but not limited to, rentals, material or subcontractor labor

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

High school diploma or equivalency certificate
8+ years of experience in the construction industry
4+ years of experience leading the coordination of multiple trades on site

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Knowledge of electrical, plumbing, heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration (HVAC/R), concrete, framing, and industrial gas trade
Knowledge of basic engineering and construction principles and methods
Ability to conduct all business in a professional and ethical manner to serve customers
Skilled in reading and interpreting engineering drawings, specifications and calculations; ability to mark up and highlight coordination items
Demonstrated ability to independently and effectively manage projects in an extremely fast paced and changing environment
Proficient knowledge in Microsoft Office Suite tools and PDF editor software such as Bluebeam or Adobe Acrobat
Ability to work in a high-stress environment balancing several projects at any given time and the flexibility to adjust for abrupt changes in strategic direction

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Ability to work extended hours and/or weekends as necessary to meet business needs
Ability to provide 24x7 on-call support in emergency situations
Physical effort including standing, lifting and carrying moderately heavy materials or equipment (25 lbs.)
Occasional travel may be required based on project tasks
Willingness to work outdoors in an environment requiring exposure to extreme temperatures and elevations
Ability to work onsite at our College Station, TX facility (Remote work not considered)
ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. About Loenbro
Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.
At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.
Job SummaryThis position is working on a heavy industrial construction worksite. The Carpenter Journeyman will work with the job supervisor to complete projects under contract. A successful candidate will be able to collaborate with a team of professionals to complete these projects within the projected deadline and under budget.
Essential Job Responsibilities

Constructing, fabricating, installing and dismantling form work of fixtures of metal, wood, and other accessories, rod-busting and concrete finishing.
Ability to read and interpret instructions.
Document, plan, and perform work activities independently.
Read and interpret blueprints.
Perform all other job duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications
Required:

2 years of form setting, rod-busting and concrete finishing experience in an industrial construction setting
Extensive knowledge of industrial construction practices, procedures, techniques, tools and equipment, materials, specifications, quality control, cost control, and adherence to applicable building codes and must be proficient at reading blueprints.
Must be able to pass pre-employment drug and alcohol screening.

Preferred:

Must be able to clearly explain steps and provide clear directions.
Must be able to complete and complete the paperwork required for purchase orders, time sheets, etc. and answer questions about the construction processes for field staff and other subcontractors.
Must be willing to embrace the company’s core values.

Physical Demands and Work Environment
The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Work Environment:

Potential exposure to extreme cold and hot temperatures.
Manufacturing, pipeline, and refining environment.
Fit and move in confined spaces including tanks and vessels.
Limited working surfaces.
Exposure to noise above 85 decibels and intense odors.
Exposure to areas with limited visibility.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

title: HVAC Programmer (Starbase)
description:

The HVAC Programmer at SpaceX works in a fast-paced environment, where the extraordinary becomes the everyday. The HVAC Programmer develops and integrates new and or existing applications into the technical infrastructure and existing business processes. The HVAC Programmer will create and provide a complete programming package to the System Manager/Team. The package includes but is not limited to a Sequence of Operation, Virtual Points, pre-tested programming and onsite Functional Test for assigned projects. This will involve training the technician team on how to interact with the control systems and overall helping improve all controls and automation for critical systems at the Starbase facility.
RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Set up process to write all programs and virtual points
Work in conjunction with engineers, environmental control system/HVAC lead and/or manager in order to produce controller and graphical software that will meet or exceed engineers, environmental control system/HVAC lead and/or manager’s expectations
Incorporate third party software into the design of building environmental control automation systems
Identify and obtain the necessary components to network the building automation system workstations; configure the software necessary to network the workstations
Set-up virtual and/or physical test system to test all programming prior to release to the field
Create functional test checkout sheets to be included in specialist checkout books
Provide technical support before, during and after system installation to the engineers, environmental control system/HVAC lead and/or manager regarding environmental control automation system
Provide recommendations to both engineering and technical teams as to how to make the environmental control automation systems more reliable
Provide in-house software support and assist in maintenance of existing system software
Provide onsite assistance at critical facilities with functional testing as required
Perform administrative duties such as expense reports, documentation of detail issues and time spent on tasks within work order system, writing weekly reports, acquiring vendor quotes, submitting purchase orders, etc.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

High school diploma or equivalency certificate
3+ years of experience with HVAC, pneumatic, mechanical, electrical systems and control systems

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

3+ years of experience programming HVAC control strategies
Associate degree or 1-2 years of vocational technical training
Specialized skill training/certification
Strong leadership and organizational skills
4+ years of experience with Johnson Controls or Andover Controls or Siemens Controls
Detail oriented, organized, and demonstrates a high sense of urgency
Able to work autonomously

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Willingness to work all required shift hours, including overtime and weekends, as needed
Must be willing to travel to various SpaceX locations for mission critical projects

We are seeking an experienced HVAC DDC BAS Controls Project Manager will work as part of a team which will be responsible for the installation, programming, start-up, troubleshooting, commissioning and servicing of DDC building automation systems. This position requires the ability to communicate clearly with customers, mechanical contractors, mechanical engineers and fellow employees.
Responsibilities

Manage installation subcontractor during construction phase of project to keep them on track and on schedule.
Manage the checkout, start-up and commissioning on BAS projects.
Schedule Programmer and Technicians after install is finished to program and commission project.

Review and correct submittal documents for BAS projects.
Create monthly AIA forms for progressive billings.
Work with customers to establish successful project schedule.
Attend jobsite meetings to discuss BAS progress and any issues holding up our progress.
Document all construction issues that handle project completion.
Analyze problems and resolve issues to ensure the complete system functions properly.
Review and correction of submittal documentation for new BAS projects.
Must be familiar with various hand and power tools.
Coordinate customer-training and complete closeout documents
Provide technical support and direction to end-users and employees when applicable.

The Required Profile

5 years of experience as a Project Manager on HVAC Building Automation Systems, LON, BACnet, and Niagara Tridium.
Some flexibility to work overtime/weekends.
Proficient in reading plans, submittal drawings and wiring diagrams.
Both written and verbal communication skills a must.
General understanding of IP networks.
Occasional travel may be required.
5 Years of Project Management with Tridium, Lonworks and BACnet Control Systems
High School Diploma, Military Service, and/or Trade School
Valid driver’s license with clean driving history.
Niagara Tridium AX and N4, familiar with Siemens Talon, and/or Distech Controls.

title: HVAC Controls Specialist Supervisor
description:
Texas AirSystems has been shaping the HVAC landscape in Texas for over four decades. With 500+ team members and seven offices statewide, we partner with over 60 leading manufacturers to deliver custom, high-performance solutions that stand the test of time.
Here, your work matters. You’ll be part of a team that values collaboration, rewards curiosity, and gives you the tools to keep growing. Whether you’re just getting started or looking for your next big challenge, this is a place where you can thrive and make a real impact.The Opportunity
The Controls Specialist Supervisor serves as a senior technical leader and people manager within the Controls organization, responsible for overseeing the execution of complex Building Automation System (BAS) projects while leading and developing a team of Controls Specialists and Technicians.  This role combines advanced technical expertise with supervisory responsibility to ensure high-quality project delivery, standardization of best practices, and continuous development of team capability.  The Controls Specialist Supervisor acts as a key escalation point for technical issues and plats a critical role in aligning field execution with operational and business objectives. 
Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Project Oversight:

Oversee and support the execution of large-scale, multi-system BAS projects from initiation through commissioning and closeout.
Architect and review control strategies, sequences of operation, and system designs for complex applications.
Provide advanced diagnostics, troubleshooting, and system optimization support across projects.
Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical challenges.

Team Leadership & Development

Supervise, coach, and develop a team of Controls Specialists and Technicians.
Conduct performance management activities, including goal setting, feedback, and development planning.
Support hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Commissioning & Quality Assurance

Ensure commissioning activities are executed effectively and systems meet design specifications and customer expectations.
Drive quality standards across all projects, ensuring consistency in programming, installation, and system performance.
Identify opportunities for system improvements, energy efficiency, and operational optimization.

Standardization & Continuous Improvement

Establish and enforce best practices, technical standards, and programming consistency across the Controls team.
Lead initiatives to improve processes, tools, and methodologies to enhance operational efficiency and scalability.

Preconstruction & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Sales and Engineering teams to support estimating, design reviews, and project planning.
Provide technical guidance on system architecture, integration strategies, and project feasibility.
Collaborate with Operations to align field execution with project schedules and financial objectives.

The Required Profile

Advanced expertise in DDC programming, controls architecture, and BAS design.
Strong experience with multi-protocol integration, including BASnet, Modbus, and LonWorks.
Advanced knowledge of IP networking and troubleshooting within BAS environments.
Experience with energy analytics, system optimization, and performance tuning.
Deep understanding of HVAC mechanical systems and their interaction with control systems.
6 – 10+ years of experience in Building Automation Systems (BAS/BMS).
Prior experience in a lead, supervisory, or project leadership role preferred.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex BAS projects and mentor technical teams.
Recognized as a technical subject matter expert in controls systems.
Relevant certifications or experience with BAS platforms such as Niagara, Distech, or similar preferred.

Work Environment
This position operates in a combination of office and field environments, with regular visits to construction sites, customer facilities, and mechanical rooms.  The role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Engineering, and Field Operations.  Work environments may include exposure to varying temperatures, noise levels, and industrial conditions.  Adherence to safety protocols and use of personal protective equipment (PPE) is required during site visits.  Occasional travel may be required to support project execution and team oversight.
Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

Regularly required to stand, walk, and navigate active job sites for extended periods.
Frequent use of hands and fingers to operate tools, equipment, and computer systems.
Ability to climb ladders, access rooftops, and work within mechanical rooms or confined spaces.
Must be able to lift and carry materials or equipment up to 25 – 50 pounds as needed.
Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, and reach to inspect, troubleshoot, or support installation of control systems.
Visual acuity required to read technical documents, wiring diagrams, and digital displays.
May require extended periods of driving to and from job sites and customer locations.

  • Drive quality standards across all projects, ensuring consistency in programming, installation, and system performance.
  • Identify opportunities for system improvements, energy efficiency, and operational optimization.

Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and enforce best practices, technical standards, and programming consistency across the Controls team.
  • Lead initiatives to improve processes, tools, and methodologies to enhance operational efficiency and scalability.

Preconstruction & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales and Engineering teams to support estimating, design reviews, and project planning.
  • Provide technical guidance on system architecture, integration strategies, and project feasibility.
  • Collaborate with Operations to align field execution with project schedules and financial objectives.

The Required Profile

  • Advanced expertise in DDC programming, controls architecture, and BAS design.
  • Strong experience with multi-protocol integration, including BASnet, Modbus, and LonWorks.
  • Advanced knowledge of IP networking and troubleshooting within BAS environments.
  • Experience with energy analytics, system optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Deep understanding of HVAC mechanical systems and their interaction with control systems.
  • 6 – 10+ years of experience in Building Automation Systems (BAS/BMS).
  • Prior experience in a lead, supervisory, or project leadership role preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex BAS projects and mentor technical teams.
  • Recognized as a technical subject matter expert in controls systems.
  • Relevant certifications or experience with BAS platforms such as Niagara, Distech, or similar preferred.

Work Environment

This position operates in a combination of office and field environments, with regular visits to construction sites, customer facilities, and mechanical rooms.  The role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Engineering, and Field Operations.  Work environments may include exposure to varying temperatures, noise levels, and industrial conditions.  Adherence to safety protocols and use of personal protective equipment (PPE) is required during site visits.  Occasional travel may be required to support project execution and team oversight.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

  • Regularly required to stand, walk, and navigate active job sites for extended periods.
  • Frequent use of hands and fingers to operate tools, equipment, and computer systems.
  • Ability to climb ladders, access rooftops, and work within mechanical rooms or confined spaces.
  • Must be able to lift and carry materials or equipment up to 25 – 50 pounds as needed.
  • Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, and reach to inspect, troubleshoot, or support installation of control systems.
  • Visual acuity required to read technical documents, wiring diagrams, and digital displays.
  • May require extended periods of driving to and from job sites and customer locations.

title: Fueling Facilities Technician (Starship)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.FUELING FACILITIES TECHNICIAN (STARSHIP)
The Fueling Facilities Technician is a highly skilled and respected professional responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency of fueling systems supporting Starship fleet operations. This role supports the Starship fleet maintenance team across a variety of fleet assets, including vehicles, heavy equipment, ground support equipment, generators, and related fuel storage and transfer systems. This role requires advanced technical expertise, leadership, and coordination across multiple teams to ensure mission-critical operations are executed flawlessly. The technician is a proactive leader who drives safety, mentors team members, and implements innovative solutions to enhance team performance and system reliability. SpaceX doesn’t shut down production for maintenance, and instead, we find ways to predict failures and perform the maintenance without interrupting production. This role will require direct work with the engineers and technicians who design and build unique machines and perform risk analysis together to map out the maintenance strategy and find the best condition monitoring systems to monitor the performance.
RESPONSIBILITIES

Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair fueling systems, pumps, dispensers, filtration, and transfer equipment across a variety of fleet assets, ensuring team proficiency in these areas
Implementing process improvements and physical upgrades to improve reliability of fueling operations
Execute fueling, defueling, and emergency procedures for fleet vehicles, ground support equipment, and related systems
Create basic and complex work orders from scratch for fueling assemblies and support equipment
Provide preventative and corrective maintenance on fuel storage, transfer, filtration, and dispensing systems
Develop complex rework work order dispositions, including custom hardware installs without design references and functional/leak checks post-rework
Drive fuel trucks, forklifts, and other company equipment
Design and create specialized tooling to complete projects or tasks
Trains and mentors the operations team to ensure fleet operators are capable of self-diagnosing, troubleshooting, and performing common fueling and repair tasks

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

High school diploma or equivalency certificate
2+ years of experience with fueling operations, fuel system service, or fleet maintenance

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Able to adapt to constantly changing work assignments and fast-paced work environment
Excellent concentration and attention to detail with outstanding work efficiency and accuracy
Work in compliance with the applicable SpaceX and industry standards and regulations
Understanding of hazardous materials handling, fuel quality control, and spill prevention best practices
Read and interpret engineering work instructions/drawings and verify that fueling, transfer, and loading/unloading processes are carried out successfully and in accordance with the fueling plan
Proven track record in high-pressure, mission-critical environments
5+ years of experience as a maintenance technician or field service engineer
Experience with CAD and/or mechanical design
Experience operating a forklift, fuel truck, and other related fleet equipment
Ability to read and interpret electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic schematics and drawings
Ability to write detailed repair reports (advanced MS Office skills)
Ability to use power tools and hand tools as well as heavy equipment
Ability to maintain a safe and clean working environment while adhering to company policies, quality policies, and industry standards
Detail-oriented, organized, and able to demonstrate a high sense of urgency
Analytic thinker who gets to the root of problems and comes up with permanent solutions to remedy issues
Experience in aerospace maintenance, fleet fueling, cryogenic or hazardous commodity transfer, or vehicle assembly operations
Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Must be able to stand for extended periods (8 hours min)
Must be able to travel for short and extended trips as needed
Willing to travel up to 25%
Must be available for all shifts, overtime, and weekends as needed
Capable of lifting up to 50 lbs. unassisted and working at heights
ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Sr. Construction Safety Engineer (Terafab)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.SR. ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH & SAFETY ENGINEER, CONSTRUCTION SAFETY (TERAFAB)
We are building Terafab, a vertically integrated semiconductor factory at an unprecedented scale. The facility houses logic, memory, packaging, test, and lithography mask production under one roof, optimized for rapid iteration and maximum compute density per square foot. Additionally, the campus will include power generation and compute testing facilities that will enable fully optimized development, operation, and testing of the fabrication facility and its products.
This position requires a dedicated environmental, health, and safety professional who will be able to use their skill, knowledge, and experience to further our Environmental Health and Safety programs within our fast-paced work environment that includes operations that have never been attempted before. You will bring deep experience in construction safety, preferably with experience in the semiconductor or power generation sectors. You will have the opportunity to work across multiple projects as the site evolves, and success depends on clear communication, strong cross-functional influence, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-change environment.
RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Develop, implement, execute, and improve construction safety and contractor management programs at the Terafab location
Lead daily safety engagements with employees and contractors to drive safe operations across the site
Create, review and approve Purchase Orders and manage the operational budget for construction safety programs
Develop practical solutions that improve construction site safety, reduce incident rates, drive contractor engagement, and advance the overall EHS program
Investigate mishaps and develop sustainable improvement plans to reduce risk
Ensure EHS policies, practices, and procedures are understood and consistently followed by project teams, clients, and contractors
Collaborate with internal project teams and contractors to foster a strong safety culture that focuses on preventing serious incidents
Review and interpret new and proposed safety laws and regulations (with emphasis on construction-related requirements) and provide clear guidance to management
Provide training, coaching, and technical guidance to construction stakeholders on job hazard analyses (JHAs), safe work procedures, contractor onboarding, permits to work, and other key risk management tools to ensure consistent implementation of a robust construction safety program
Hold routine site/operation-wide Contractor Safety Steering Reviews to drive accountability for execution of EHS performance across contractor groups
Perform construction safety compliance audits, pre-task planning reviews, and contractor risk assessments to measure performance and facilitate risk reduction 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 

Bachelor’s degree
5+ years of experience in the design, development, and operational oversight of environmental, health, and safety programs with an emphasis on construction safety operations 

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, Construction Management, or related field (emphasis in Construction Safety preferred)
10+ years of experience, preferably in construction safety
Demonstrated strong organizational and communication skills with a clear aptitude and desire to influence people
Hands-on experience leading multi-site or multi-contractor construction safety programs in high-risk or complex environments
Able to review as-built drawings, assess safety-in-design opportunities, and lead technical risk engineering solutions in the design-build environment  
Strong knowledge and experience interpreting, applying, and documenting federal, state, and local construction safety regulations
Experience with fall protection, scaffolding, crane/heavy equipment safety, excavation, confined space, and contractor safety management (including contractor pre-qualification)
Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
Professional certifications such as CSP, CHST, or equivalent preferred 

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: 

Must be able to work extended hours, weekends, and travel to construction sites as needed
Must be able to work in outdoor construction environments and wear required personal protective equipment 
ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

title: Electrical Superintendent - Data Center
description:
Join the Team!
Is technology your passion? Do you want to work with smart, forward-thinking individuals? Do you want to grow in a career you love?
At Align, our professionals are the key to our success. We don’t just hire talent, we invest in exceptional people who are forward-thinking, results-driven, and passionate about what they do. We’re a group of tech-savvy professionals who are motivated by making an impact. Our culture is one of unbounded opportunity that celebrates the passions, skills and ideas of our team—work hard, play hard, be smart!
We believe great communities lead to great companies. That’s why we offer a dynamic workplace where you feel inspired, engaged and innovative. We offer professionals opportunities to train in the leading technologies, make an impact within the industry and acquire valuable new skills whether on client sites or in one of our regional offices.Position Overview
Align is seeking an experienced Electrical Superintendent to oversee onsite electrical installation for data center construction and infrastructure projects. This individual will lead field teams, coordinate subcontractors, and ensure work is completed safely, on schedule, and in accordance with project specifications.
The ideal candidate brings strong electrical construction experience, practical knowledge of power distribution systems, and a proven ability to manage field execution in data centers or other mission-critical environments. This role focuses on electrical power infrastructure, including busway, switchgear, panels, feeders, conduit, grounding, and equipment connections. Structured cabling or telecommunications experience alone does not meet the requirements.

This is a full-time, salaried position, full benefits, paid time off, paid training, and performance-based bonuses.
This position is based in the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex area and will work onsite for local data center projects.
Approximately 50% travel outside of the Texas area should be expected at times.

Responsibilities

Lead daily electrical installation activities, coordinating crews, subcontractors, and vendors
Plan manpower, materials, equipment, and work sequencing to support project schedules
Oversee installation of power distribution equipment, busway, RPPs, PDUs, conduit, feeders, grounding, and electrical containment
Review drawings, one-line diagrams, specifications, and submittals to guide field execution
Coordinate with project managers, general contractors, clients, and other trades to resolve installation conflicts
Monitor workmanship and progress, addressing deficiencies and schedule risks early
Maintain daily reports, progress updates, and field documentation; support RFIs, change orders, and as-built updates
Enforce site safety requirements and approved procedures for shutdowns, tie-ins, and work in operational facilities
Coordinate inspections and support testing, commissioning, energization readiness, and project turnover
Manage punch-list completion and ensure installations meet project quality standards

Qualifications

3-5 years of electrical construction experience, including three years in a Superintendent, General Foreman, or comparable field leadership role
Experience leading electrical work in data centers, mission-critical facilities, or complex industrial environments
Strong knowledge of electrical power distribution, equipment installation, conduit, feeders, grounding, and bonding
Ability to interpret electrical drawings, one-line diagrams, specifications, and equipment submittals
Experience supervising crews, coordinating subcontractors, and managing field schedules and resources
Strong communication, organization, problem-solving, and client relationship skills
Familiarity with Procore, Bluebeam, Microsoft Office, or similar project tools

Preferred Qualifications

Journeyman or master electrician license
OSHA 30 certification
Experience with hyperscale or colocation data centers and white space electrical fit-outs
Experience working in live facilities and supporting commissioning, shutdowns, and energization

To support a fair, consistent, and high-quality hiring experience, some interviews may be recorded. These recordings help our team focus fully on the conversation at hand, rather than note-taking, and allow us to better evaluate and improve our recruitment process. Recordings are used solely for internal purposes such as training, quality assurance, and process improvement. Candidates will be informed in advance and asked to provide consent before any recording takes place.

Benefits and Perks:

At Align, we believe that supporting our employees both personally and professionally is key to our success. We offer a competitive benefits package designed to promote health, wellness, financial security, and work-life balance, including:

Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options

401(k) plan with a dollar-for-dollar company match at 3% up to an annual maximum of $5k.

Complimentary ClassPass membership to support your health and wellness goals
Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
Company-paid holidays
Cellphone Reimbursement Program
Floating Holiday to celebrate a day that is meaningful to you
Pre-tax commuter benefits, where applicable
Employee wellness programs, events, and team-building activities
Employee referral program

Align is a premier global provider of technology infrastructure solutions.
Align specializes in designing and deploying technology infrastructure solutions from the data center to the desktop as well as providing managed IT services for clients.
Our professional services team, which includes Data Center Solutions, provide strategic consulting, design, project management, engineering, implementation and support. Our best-in-class Managed Services team provides IT services and cybersecurity advisory for clients within the Alternative Investment industry. Align is a Microsoft Tier 1 Cloud Solutions Provider (CSP) and Gold Partner.
Our client centric approach and passion for driving IT innovation has enabled us to provide tailored solutions and business transformations for over three decades. Leading firms have relied on Align to provide forward-thinking technology strategies that support their current and future business needs.
Our teams have flawless track records of delivering technical solutions and have established long-standing relationships with an impressive client list of both Global 1000 and SMB clients. We work across a diverse list of industries including financial services, life sciences (pharmaceutical and health care), retail, technology, media and telecommunications.
For more information, visit: www.align.com

You will influence Data Center design documents for: One-lines, Switchgear, UPS, Panelboards, Transformers, Power, Lighting, Lighting Control Systems, grounding, Fire Alarm systems, Short Circuit and Arc Flash analysis, Cable tray and Cable pathways for Ethernet and Fiber systems. You will produce, maintain and publish permit Electrical Engineering drawing sets for our fleet of Data Centers.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
Daily responsibilities will include designing the electrical systems of Data Centers, and utilizing Revit to create and maintain BIM models. You must be able to work independently and work within a team environment to accomplish assigned tasks. This includes working with internal groups as well as external suppliers and consultants, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors. Your duties will include:

• Be self-motivated and work within the MEP group as well as within other teams.
• Understanding of electrical engineering calculations and studies, such as short circuit, arc flash analysis.
• Ability to perform voltage drop calculations, raceway and conductor sizing, and grounding system conductor sizing.
• Preparing and developing detailed Revit models of electrical building systems.
• Developing & publishing construction documentation for electrical building systems designs in a fast-paced environment to meet scheduled deliverables.
• Updating and modifying existing models, studies and construction documents as required with coordination of engineering group.
• Assist with creating and maintaining standard regional BIM templates.
• Participate in design coordination meetings with other trades for clash detection and resolution.
• Work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical locations.
• Assist the project team with information exchange processes between internal and external customers.
• Provide coordination support for information requests during construction phases.
• Recording and reporting of key metrics to management.
• Travel to Data Center sites for engineering evaluations and surveys as required. On average, once or twice a year.
• Be positive and always offer creative, out of the box solutions.
• Have fun and work hard!


A day in the life
As a designer, you will collaborate across disciplines and teams to refine data center designs. Your work includes creating detailed models, drawings, specification, prototypes, and updating managers and leaders of changes to the building design. You engage in design discussions, review feedback from peers and collaborators, and adjust designs to ensure our data center solutions meet the highest standards of efficiency and quality.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
o We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.


Basic Qualifications

- 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- 4+ years of commissioning experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- Experience in commissioning
- 4+ years’ experience using Revit for producing Electrical engineering BIM models and construction drawings.
- Practical knowledge and understanding of electrical codes (NEC) and safety regulations.
- Ability to conduct lighting illumination calculations.
- Understanding of power distribution and as represented by Single Line diagrams, plans and schedules.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

title: I&E Technician
description:
Who We Are:
Headquartered in Austin, TX with operations in Kermit and Monahans, TX, Atlas Energy Solutions is the leading provider of high-quality frac sand and innovative logistics solutions to Exploration & Production operators and oil field service providers in the Permian Basin. We are proud of what we do – we have state of the art manufacturing facilities, premium offerings, outstanding customer service, and exceptional work culture and a commitment to giving back to the community.
We’re very excited about what we see in front of us, and we think you will be too – so come join our team and contribute   to our growth!
How You Will Make an Impact:
The I & E Technician is critical to ensuring the Conveyor stays running.  Atlas prides itself on being a technology driven company and a critical piece of that is maintaining our sensors and hardware at the plants. 
Responsibilities:

Calibrate, troubleshoot and repair plant instrumentation, transmitters, analyzers, control valves, switches and relays
Diagnose and correct problems associated with PLC’s and electrical systems & controls.
Plan details of jobs that are assigned.
Ability to use blueprints, sketches and complex drawings.
Tools used by I&E technicians include oscilloscopes, signal generators, voltmeters, multimeters, and high and low voltage detectors.
Inspect, troubleshoot, and maintain process control systems such as Control Logix PLC’s, analog and discrete IO devices, and Ethernet IP communications.
Ability to troubleshoot intelligent motor starters with E300 communication modules
Ability to troubleshoot Allan Bradley lines of PowerFlex VFDs and Allan Bradley Soft Starts

Qualifications:

Ability to work in a manufacturing environment both indoors and outdoors.
Previous experience working with electronic communication devices such as oscilloscopes, signal generators, voltmeters, multimeters, and high and low voltage detectors.
Experience reading product manuals and troubleshooting equipment.
Ability to calibrate a wide array of sensors and detectors.

What You’ll Love About Us:

Your Well-Being is a 100% covered Medical, Dental, and Vision

About Loenbro
Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.
At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.
Job SummaryThe EHS Coordinator plays an essential role in establishing and promoting a culture of safety within the specific sites they are assigned, focusing on compliance with both internal EHS policies and external regulatory requirements. This position involves overseeing EHS protocols at a specific site, ensuring the site adheres to the highest standards of workplace safety and health. By conducting regular audits, providing training, and implementing EHS programs, the EHS Coordinator II works to minimize risks, reduce workplace accidents, and maintain a safe, healthy environment for all employees. Through collaboration with various departments and site leadership teams, this role supports the organization’s commitment to safety, demonstrating the importance of proactive measures in safeguarding the well-being of its workforce.

This position involves overseeing EHS protocols at a specific site, ensuring the site adheres to the highest standards of workplace safety and health

Through collaboration with various departments and site leadership teams, this role supports the organization’s commitment to safety, demonstrating the importance of proactive measures in safeguarding the well-being of its workforce

Minimum Qualifications
Required: 

OSHA 30 required.
Minimum 5 years prior experience working within the heavy industrial construction industry, including manufacturing, pipeline, mining, food and beverage, power, and refining environments with at least 3 years in a safety role.
Working knowledge of OSHA regulations, standards, and other applicable codes/regulations.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to assess potential hazards and risks within operations and develop and implement strategies to mitigate them effectively.

CSST or Equivalent
MSHA Certification or background preferred.

Limited working surfaces

Climbing up and down stairs and ladders to both get in and out of trenches and up to elevated platforms (scaffolding at significant heights)

The Conveyor Maintenance Supervisor provides technical support for the safe and efficient operation of the 42-mile-long Dune Express equipment. Duties include but are not limited to assisting maintenance in repairing equipment such as conveyors, compressors, pumps, diesel engines and control devices. Assist in troubleshooting issues, repairs, failures of production and facilities equipment and ensures maximum efficiency and effectiveness of operations.  Work with planner/scheduler on coordinating jobs and required downtime.  Help develop SOP’s and PM’s to improve operations and mechanic job skills.  Understands process flow and evaluates ways to increase operating efficiency.
 
Safety:

Proper Lockout/Tagout procedures
Pre-shift/Operational inspections.
Safe operation of plant equipment.
Wear proper PPE, i.e., safety boots, safety glasses, goggles and face shields, hard hats, welding helmets and fall protection.
Safety meetings with crews

title: Planning and Delivery Manager  (Owner's Representative) - Data Center Construction (Hybrid)
description:
KALCON is seeking an experienced and field-oriented Scheduler / Planning & Delivery Manager to support the successful delivery of mission-critical data center construction projects. Acting as an extension of the Owner's Representative team, this role provides on-site schedule leadership, construction planning support, schedule validation, and delivery oversight throughout construction, commissioning, and turnover activities. The position may support projects where the client is acting as either the tenant within a third-party developed facility or as the developer delivering space for a tenant, requiring flexibility in how the role engages with project stakeholders and contractors.
Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field preferred. Experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
5+ years of experience supporting commercial, industrial, mission-critical, manufacturing, infrastructure, or large-scale construction projects in a field-based construction, scheduling, project engineering, superintendent, construction management, or planning role
Proven experience utilizing Primavera P6 to develop, maintain, analyze, and validate construction schedules in support of active field operations.
Strong understanding of construction means and methods, trade sequencing, site logistics, procurement, commissioning, startup, turnover, and operational readiness activities.
Experience working directly with General Contractors, superintendents, subcontractors, and trade partners to validate schedule assumptions, construction sequencing, manpower loading, and reported progress against actual field conditions.
Ability to identify schedule risks, analyze critical path activities, evaluate recovery plans, and communicate schedule impacts and recommendations to project teams and leadership.
Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence stakeholders, challenge assumptions, and drive accountability in a fast-paced construction environment.
Ability to maintain a consistent on-site presence, perform routine field walks, and travel as required to support project assignments.

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience supporting mission-critical, data center, hyperscale, colocation, AI infrastructure, or other technically complex construction projects.
Experience working within an Owner's Representative, developer, tenant-representative, or owner's project management environment.
Experience integrating construction schedules with commissioning, startup, testing, and turnover milestones.
Familiarity with Pull Planning, Last Planner System®, Lean Construction principles, or collaborative planning methodologies.
PSP, PMP, CCM, or similar industry certifications.

Duties and Responsibilities:
Field Validation & Construction Planning

Maintain an active on-site presence to validate that contractor schedules, sequencing plans, and reported progress accurately reflect field conditions and actual construction activities.
Work directly with General Contractor schedulers, superintendents, and trade partners to evaluate construction sequencing, crew loading, workfront availability, and execution readiness.
Walk the project regularly to identify schedule risks, coordination conflicts, access constraints, material shortages, and productivity issues before they impact project milestones.
Provide independent feedback to project leadership regarding schedule health, field performance, and the realism of contractor planning assumptions.

Schedule Management & Analysis

Own and maintain the owner's view of the project schedule, incorporating field observations, contractor updates, procurement activities, commissioning milestones, and project priorities.
Review contractor Primavera P6 schedules, logic, float trends, milestone forecasts, and recovery plans to evaluate alignment with actual construction progress.
Analyze schedule changes, delays, recovery strategies, and critical path activities to identify risks and opportunities impacting project delivery.
Challenge schedule assumptions and progress updates that are inconsistent with field conditions or observed construction performance

Project Coordination & Delivery Support

Participate in weekly planning meetings, look-ahead reviews, contractor coordination meetings, and superintendent planning sessions to support reliable project execution.
Coordinate construction sequencing with procurement, equipment deliveries, commissioning activities, startup events, and turnover milestones.
Track owner-furnished equipment, vendor activities, and long-lead procurement items that may affect schedule performance and project delivery.
Support project teams in identifying recovery opportunities and implementing mitigation strategies when schedule risks are identified.

Commissioning & Turnover Integration

Align construction schedules with commissioning, startup, testing, and turnover milestones to ensure project delivery remains focused on operational readiness.
Support integration of Level 1 through Level 5 commissioning activities into project planning and schedule coordination efforts.
Monitor readiness for system startup, turnover, and commissioning activities and identify constraints that may affect completion dates.
Coordinate with project controls, commissioning teams, contractors, and vendors to ensure schedule priorities support successful turnover objectives.

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

Prepare weekly schedule reports, milestone updates, and risk summaries highlighting key project activities, constraints, delays, and recovery actions.
Communicate schedule performance, emerging risks, and recommended actions to project leadership in a clear and actionable manner.
Build effective working relationships with contractors, superintendents, vendors, consultants, and project stakeholders to promote collaboration and schedule accountability.
Support projects operating under either tenant-representation or developer delivery models and adapt communication and coordination approaches accordingly.

Benefits Offered: 

Medical insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Life Insurance
Accident Insurance
Long Term Disability
401(k) retirement plan with 4% KALCON match when an employee contributes at least 5%
15 days of paid time off
8 paid National Holidays
Reimbursement for professional licenses and certifications

Submission Requirements: 
At a minimum, the candidate’s professional resume must include the following:

List of all Educational Achievements
List of all Professional Licenses or Certificates
List of Awards Received
Detailed Employment History with each company including:

Name & Contact Information of the firm or agency
Start Date and End Date (Month & Year)
Positions Held

At KALCON we are committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace where every individual is respected and valued. We are an equal opportunity employer and all applicant and employees will receive consideration for employment as we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetics, protected veteran status or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. We believe that a diverse workforce contributes to the success of our company and the innovation behind the exceptional projects we deliver. We encourage and support applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our team and thrive. Our hiring and employment practices are guided by principles of fairness, equality, and opportunity for all. 
 Salary Range$140,000—$200,000 USD

title: QA/QC Technician
description:
Job Title: QA/QC Technician
Company: Loenbro, LLCBusiness Unit/Department: Quality Control - South Region                                      Location: Red Oak, TXReports to:  QA/QC ManagerEmployment Type: Full-TimeFLSA Classification: Non-Exempt
About Loenbro
Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.
At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.
Job SummaryAs an Electrical QA/QC Technician at Loenbro, you will play a critical role in ensuring the highest quality and safety standards are met throughout our electrical projects. You will be responsible for conducting inspections, tests, and quality control measures to maintain our reputation for excellence.
Essential Job Responsibilities 

Quality Assurance: Develop and maintain a robust quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) program for electrical projects, including the review of project plans and specifications.
Inspection: Conduct thorough inspections of electrical installations, equipment, and materials to verify compliance with industry standards, codes, and project requirements.
Testing: Perform electrical testing, measurements, and functional checks to ensure the integrity, safety, and reliability of electrical systems.
Documentation: Maintain detailed records of inspections, test results, and any non-conformance issues. Prepare and submit comprehensive reports to project managers and clients.
Compliance: Ensure that all electrical work complies with local, state, and national electrical codes and regulations.
Problem-Solving: Collaborate with project teams to identify and resolve quality-related issues in a timely manner.
Training: Provide guidance and support to project personnel regarding quality and safety standards, fostering a culture of quality excellence.

 
Other duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.
Minimum Qualifications
Required: 

1-3 years of previous experience in quality assurance/quality control roles within the electrical industry is highly desirable.
Degree in Electrical Engineering, Quality Control, or a related field (Preferred).
Strong knowledge of electrical codes, industry standards, and regulations.
Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills.
Effective communication and documentation skills.
Proficiency in the use of testing equipment and tools.
Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

As an Electrical QA/QC Technician at Loenbro, you will play a critical role in ensuring the highest quality and safety standards are met throughout our electrical projects. title: Construction Superintendent (Starship Pad Build)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not.
